data.title: Fractal Bitcoin: Permanently burns 4,101,541 FB at first halving - By 09 Sep 2026
data.description:
Fractal Bitcoin is set to permanently burn 4,101,541 FB when its first halving is activated, preventing those tokens from entering circulation.

The burn removes unused allocations before they can circulate, reducing the supply that would otherwise be added when the first halving is activated. Investors may view that as a reduction in potential supply pressure linked to the halving.

The announcement establishes a change in token availability, not demonstrated adoption or a market response. Its effect therefore depends on whether these allocations would otherwise have entered circulation.

data.title: Fractal Bitcoin: publishes the FIP-102 draft - 09 Aug 2026
data.description:
